<function name="SetMouseX" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the delta of the angular horizontal mouse movement of the player.

See also <page>CUserCmd:SetMouseY</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="speed" type="number">Angular horizontal move delta.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
